items.title: 20.5 Formation of human insulin in bacteria (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of human insulin from bacteria (PDF 165).

blocks.text: Insani insulin banana genetic engineering ki pehli bari kamyabi thi. Bacteria ke zariye sciencedan pancreas ke qudrati hormone jaisi insulin bohat bari miqdar mein banate hain. Insulin ki do polypeptide zanjeerein alag banti aur phir kimiyai taur par jorri jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Bacteria se bani insulin itni ahem kamyabi kyun thi?
blocks.explanation: Diabetes ke mareezon ke liye insani insulin jaisi insulin bari miqdar mein banayi ja saki.

items: Bacteria se insani insulin: do zanjeerein alag bana kar jorri jati hain.
